question: How many open claims does each VIC & TAS adjuster have?

input.sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, a.leave_date, count(c.claim_id) open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id and c.status='open' where a.region='VIC & TAS' group by all order by open_claims desc

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract, as in the agreed open_claims metric) currently assigned to each adjuster whose region is VIC & TAS. All three adjusters who have left are included, so they show as 0 rather than being dropped. The count uses the claims.adjuster_id field, which is the adjuster currently responsible.
report.answer: The five current VIC & TAS adjusters hold 125 open claims between them. Brian Haynes (ADJ-013) has 31, Danielle Garza (ADJ-016) 26, Theresa Hughes (ADJ-017) 25, Gregory Cooley (ADJ-015) 22 and John Young II (ADJ-014) 21. The three adjusters who left in June 2026 have none: Kevin Smith (ADJ-010), Sharon Murphy (ADJ-011) and Deborah Torres (ADJ-012). Brian Haynes has about 6 more open claims than the average of the other four, which may be worth a look at workload balance.
